children: Celcuity reported updated VIKTORIA-1 PIK3CA MT cohort data: median PFS up to 21.5 months with the gedatolisib triplet vs 9.1 months for alpelisib+fulvestrant in patients without liver mets; TEAE discontinuations 5%/4% for triplet/doublet vs 19% for alpelisib.

Shows benefit even without CDK4/6, supporting flexible use and broader addressable patients.
ORR 59% triplet vs 33% control
Higher responses can drive faster physician adoption and market share.
DoR 19.4m triplet vs 7.5m control
Longer durability supports sustained treatment duration and revenue per patient.
TEAE discontinuation 5%/4% vs 19%
Lower discontinuations vs alpelisib improve real-world adherence and commercial competitiveness.
Grade 3 stomatitis <3% by cycle 2
Manageable safety profile reduces risk of drop-offs, aiding payer and physician support.
